name: agent-canvas
description: Build and run local visual AI workflows from Codex through Agent Canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run visual AI workflows directly from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Agent Canvas lets Codex inspect, assemble, connect, validate, and run local prompt, image, and video workflows through revision-safe semantic tools. Generation tasks stay visible in the Agent Canvas task center and write their outputs back to connected nodes even when the browser is closed.
defaultPrompt: Build an image-generation workflow in Agent Canvas.
Inspect my Agent Canvas and improve its wiring.
Run the configured video node and monitor its task.
